summary: Retire the report in steps, but keep the model for now. About a dozen managers still open the report weekly, a Monday subscription goes to all regional managers, and an executive dashboard tile is pinned from it. Its model also feeds the monthly Commission Statement (payroll) and Finance's regional targets workbook. Deleting the model today would break payroll on the 1st.
steps: Usage: views fell from ~210 to ~60 a week in April, so ~11–12 people still use it weekly. Find who, and ask why (missing feature in Sales Overview?).
Report dependencies: Monday subscription (owner Dana), dashboard tile on Exec Overview.
Model dependencies: Commission Statement paginated report (Payroll, monthly), Regional targets.xlsx via Analyze in Excel (Finance).

Plan: week 1 notify viewers, subscription owner and dashboard owner; add a banner pointing to Sales Overview; move the tile. Week 3: report read-only, subscription moved to Sales Overview. Week 6: archive the report.
Model: repoint the Commission Statement and the Finance workbook to the certified model, run a parallel payroll cycle, then retire the model.

review.junior: Deletes the report and the model because usage dropped.
review.competent: Checks usage and the subscription, retires the report.
review.senior: Separates report and model, finds every dependency including payroll and Excel, plans staged retirement with notifications and a parallel run.
review.architect: Turns it into a standard retirement process and reports retirement candidates quarterly from usage and lineage.
